This is our first juicer and wanted it to last us a while, we had a great deal on it when amazon presented the price so I had to snag it.  The Juicer is great overall and very fast to create juice when doing watermelon, apples, carrots etc... Although the spin is fast, it does creates foam when it hits the jug, so you would have to let it settle, unless you like the foam.  Overall, very satisfied with the machine and have been using it regularly, clean it is great, very well made and heavy so it doesnt vibrate off your table.  Recommend to purchase if you're in a market for one.
